run.name: Telus Corp
run.title: CP-OS host session (TU)
run.summary: TELUS has solid liquidity and covenant headroom, but leverage is above its own objective and depends on equity credit, cash interest cover is falling and guidance has been cut. The credit is under pressure. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is TELUS CORP.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Total debt is calculated: long-term debt including current maturities and lease liabilities 30,231 plus short-term borrowings 1,225 = 31,456, over LTM EBITDA excluding restructuring and other costs 7,315. Net debt is the issuer figure 25,963 over 7,315, which gives 3.55 unrounded; the issuer reports 3.5. Issuer net debt deducts half equity credit for junior subordinated notes.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. EBITDA excluding restructuring and other costs 7,315 over cash interest paid 1,585 (Q3 2025 399, Q4 2025 306, Q1 2026 430, Q2 2026 450). Cash interest paid includes the interest component of lease payments and, in Q2 2026, a prepayment premium on a promissory note; it is gross of interest received. The issuer's own measure, EBITDA over net interest cost, is 4.9.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Audited 2025 statements, deal and financing agreements, named ratings and anything after July 31, 2026 are not supplied.
CP-1 main limitation: Audited 2025 statements and second-quarter notes are not supplied, so 2025 totals are assembled from quarters and debt detail is dated March 31, 2026.
